text: The applicant should be under the age of 40 with good health and must have Bachelor's degree or a similar graduation certificate equivalent to a Bachelor's degree holder in China. Undergraduate courses, academic transcripts and two recommendation letters from two professors or associate professors should be submitted. He /She may be recruited after examination and approval by the University. Applicants should have attained a higher level of competence in English and be able to use it in pursuing study and research in their special field.
